units.text: If you have a Class A CDL issued by the NY DMV, you must certify to the type of commercial driving you perform or expect to perform, choosing one of four federal driving types (e.g., exempt or non-exempt interstate/intrastate).
units.reason: The context states that CDL holders must certify to the type of commercial driving and choose from four federal driving types.

units.text: If you self-certify as a non-exempt type (NA or NI), you must also keep a current USDOT Medical Examiner's Certificate on file with the DMV.
units.reason: The context explicitly states that self-certifying as non-exempt (NA or NI) requires keeping a current USDOT Medical Examiner's Certificate on file.

units.text: You must provide this certification when conducting any DMV transaction (except address changes or duplicate licenses).
units.reason: The context states that certification is required for any DMV transaction except address changes or duplicate licenses.
